faq.title: Before you register
faq.subtitle: Quick answers for new Ancient Wisdom wholesale customers.

items.question: Who can open a wholesale account?
items.answer: Ancient Wisdom supplies genuine businesses, including independent shops, online retailers, market traders and wellbeing businesses. The account is intended for customers purchasing products for resale or professional business use.

items.question: Is registration free?
items.answer: Yes. There is no fee to create an Ancient Wisdom wholesale account.

items.question: Is there a minimum order value?
items.answer: No. Ancient Wisdom has no minimum order value, so you can choose the products and quantities that suit your business.

items.question: When can I see wholesale prices?
items.answer: Wholesale prices are available when you are logged into your registered trade account. Start by selecting “Create my wholesale account” above.

items.question: Do online-only retailers qualify?
items.answer: Yes. Online shops and marketplace sellers can register, as can physical retailers and other genuine businesses.

items.question: Do I need a VAT number?
items.answer: Complete the registration form with the tax information that applies to your business and country. If you are unsure what to provide, contact customer care before submitting your registration.
